Amidst Mumbai's chaos, the COVID crisis upends Ayush and Roohi's lives as Ayush faces unemployment. Consequently, Roohi launches a meal delivery venture to sustain their household. A newly wedded woman faces colourism from her mother-in-law. While her husband wants to fight this prejudice, she decides to navigate it and maintain her dignity within the family.
